lesson.title: Ich würde mich gern vorstellen
lesson.english_title: I Would Like to Introduce Myself

sentences.text: Sehr geehrte Frau Koch, ich würde mich vor dem Gespräch gern persönlich vorstellen.
sentences.natural_meaning: Dear Ms Koch, I would like to introduce myself in person before the interview.

verb_help.usage: This form makes a request or possibility polite or hypothetical.
This non-finite form follows a modal verb or zu, so it does not change for person in this sentence.

items.german: ich würde mich vor dem Gespräch gern persönlich vorstellen
items.english: I would like to introduce myself in person before the interview

sentences.text: Ich habe mich um die Stelle beworben und Ihnen meinen Lebenslauf gestern per E-Mail geschickt.
sentences.natural_meaning: I applied for the position and sent you my CV by email yesterday.

verb_help.usage: The sentence uses the present tense for a current action, routine, plan, or general fact.
beworben is the past participle of bewerben; it combines with haben to form the conversational past.
geschickt is the past participle of schicken; it combines with haben to form the conversational past.

items.german: habe mich um die Stelle beworben

sentences.text: Am Dienstag um zehn Uhr oder am Mittwoch um vierzehn Uhr würde ich für ein Gespräch zur Verfügung stehen.
sentences.natural_meaning: I would be available for an interview on Tuesday at ten or Wednesday at 2 p.m.

lesson.initial_question: Which two interview times does Mina suggest?
lesson.initial_answer: Tuesday at ten and Wednesday at 2 p.m.
lesson.topic: writing a polite email to arrange an interview

performance_activity.instruction: Draft a 50–60 word formal email: state interest, offer Tuesday at ten and Wednesday at 2 p.m., and ask for confirmation.
prompts: Polite interest using ich würde gern
